verdicts.note: Subject is the only woman on the team and self-refers as a woman throughout; female clearly supported.
Quote is thin alone but whole interview confirms she is currently on her placement year, finishing in August.
She is actively working on placement with the organisation; yes is correct.
Quote describes uni's framing of placement value as experience and she endorses it; indirect for own motivation, downgrade to low.
Quote compares placement responsibilities to the outside world; only loosely about seeing what industry is really like, downgrade to low.
In direct reply to whether placement helps get a job she affirms and cites sponsorship; agree supported.
Clearly negative about uni group work ('so artificial'); dissatisfied (not very dissatisfied) fits.
Explicitly prefers the managerial side over technical/specialist; managerial supported.
Quote is about sponsorship but full context (Wing Commander/Squadron Leader, six-year sign-up, intends to stay) supports Armed Forces related.
'Training when I leave' is Armed Forces professional/career training, not academic further study; she looks forward to finishing uni. Does not support further-study construct.
interper is about the COURSE developing interpersonal skills; her gain is attributed to the placement, not the degree. Wrong source, reject.
Quote is travel being the best part of the placement, not travel as a job-choice decision factor; construct is job-selection importance. Reject.
